metadata.title: 全ての速度変換区間を並べる費用は、境界の流量差と連結費用に分ける
metadata.summary: 入口上限と出口速度から生じる減速費用を最小にする。数直線の境界ごとに必要な下降量を払い、残る成分を最小費用でつなぐと、全区間を一度ずつ使える順序が得られる。
aliases: 入口上限と出口速度 境界の本数差と最小全域木
metadata.family: 数直線上の必須有向辺をつなぐ最小費用

reference.title: Roller Coaster Railroad
reference.evidence: 全区間を任意順で使う費用max(t_i-s_next,0)を、速度を頂点とする必須辺と最大速度から1への補助辺へ移す。境界ごとの必須下降量を補正し、残る弱連結成分を零差分境界の双方向辺による最小全域木で結ぶ。無料の上向き接続は入口上限の余裕を表し、物理的な加速を要求しない。
reference.verificationNotes: 原典3頁/公式17頁Solutions内Railroad3-4頁/Notice/JP日付を独立再読。全原典N2..200000・両速度1..1e9とexact C++型導出を確認。掲載単一fenceの通常/ASan67533397checks/core93460/adapter76252・checksum10479858278086570783、literal11911144orders/HeldKarp5816/最大21/invalid30/fault22/20k反復成功。独立peer未実施時点の候補で、rootが承認・実rootwalk/ref登録後にresolutionのみ。実headerbytes未取得と初回researchpositive/API0は保持。 その後、rootと別担当の独立reviewが全原典範囲・証明・実fence通常ASanを再確認し、別の全degree補完列挙とEulerから実順序への構成67084件でも一致を確認して実登録した。

problemFeatureProposal.title: ジェットコースター (Roller Coaster Railroad)
features: 入口上限以下なら使用でき、出口速度が固定の全区間を一度ずつ自由な順序で並べる
初速1から単位距離ごとに速度が1減る接続を置き、その距離の合計を最小にする
区間2〜20万・速度1〜10億の整数で、等しい区間や入口と出口が同じ区間も許す

flowProposal.newAnswerLabel: 入口上限と出口速度を持つ全区間を並べ、つなぎ目の減速距離を最小にする

guards.question: 入口速度が上限以下なら使え、出口速度が固定の区間を、全て一度ずつ自由な順序で並べますか？
guards.explanation: 等しい区間や入口と出口が同じ区間も許します。先行関係など他の順序制約はありません。

guards.question: 初速1から、区間間だけで単位距離ごとに速度が1減り、その距離の合計を最小にしますか？
guards.explanation: 実際の速度は常に正です。区間の後は指定速度になり、最後の区間から初速へ戻す距離は数えません。

guards.question: 区間は2〜20万個、入口上限と出口速度は1〜10億の整数ですか？
guards.explanation: 最小距離のみを返します。大きい累積距離は64bitで扱い、補正する辺を本数分だけ作りません。

api.input: N2..200000; each entry/exit in1..1000000000. Equal pairs, equal endpoints and repeated individual values are allowed.
api.output: Minimum sum of max(previous.exit-next.entry,0) over an arbitrary permutation of all sections, with no last-to-first charge. No order or expanded Euler tour is returned.
api.emptyAndSingleton: invalid_argument; both are outside original source range.
api.invalid: invalid_argument for N/range or adapter size mismatch; every public argument is validated before scratch allocation. By-value caller-side vector copies can allocate before adapter entry.
api.allocationExceptions: std::bad_alloc and other standard allocation exceptions propagate; source arrays remain unchanged and subsequent calls have no retained state.
api.internalHelpers: line_connection_detail::DisjointSet/validate_speed/Candidate are implementation details, not independently supported external APIs.
api.time: O(NlogN); endpoint sorting and2N lower_bounds, optional-edge sorting, andO(N alpha(N)) iterative Union-Find.
api.auxiliarySpace: O(N); sorted coordinates, signed degree deltas, Union-Find parent/size, optional(length,index) edges. Standard library sort stackO(logN). No expanded edge multiplicity or recursive Euler tour.
api.memoryMeaning: Measured payloads on32bit int/64bit int64 tested GCC/libstdc++; exclude allocator overhead, caller-owned original inputs and sort stack. Adapter maximum includes its by-value argument copies, pair conversion and full core scratch, not just conversion.

integerSafety.intermediateCostBound: base <=(N+1)*(U-1), optional tree <=U-1, total <=(N+2)*(U-1)<2.00002e14; article uses the still looser safe2*(N+2)*1e9
integerSafety.positionsAndReserve: N validated beforeint cast;2*N+1<=400001;V-1 nonnegative even V1
integerSafety.multiplication: std::int64_t(balance)*gap promotes before multiplication; result/accumulator signed64

proof.transitionCost: From exit x, distance max(x-y,0) leaves speedmin(x,y)>0, accepted by next entry upper boundy. No benefit from additional slowing. Initial1 is accepted everywhere.
proof.auxiliary: U=max_i max(s_i,t_i), not max_i s_i alone. Mandatory auxiliary U->1 is entered from every last exit and followed by every first entry at zero connection cost. Thus original arrangements map to equal-cost augmented cycles.
proof.freeUpMeaning: A zero-cost x->y for x<=y encodes acceptance of actual speedx under upper boundy. It is not physical acceleration. Internal prescribed s->t transitions themselves reset exit speed.
proof.reverseAugmentation: Read required sections around a balanced weak-connected Euler circuit and cut afteraux. Between consecutive required sections, downward variation>=max(lastExit-nextEntry,0). Replacing that connector path by the physically valid direct slowdown gives an original order with no greater cost. Together with the forward reduction the optima coincide.
proof.adjacentExpansion: Any connection between two compressed speeds expands monotonically into adjacent coordinates at equal cost. It can add intermediate visited vertices but never harms legality or connectivity in the abstract augmentation model.
proof.cutBalance: delta=required outdegree-indegree, includingaux. b_j=prefix delta =required right crossings-left crossings. Every balanced augmentation has d_j-u_j=b_j, hence d_j=max(b_j,0)+z_j andu_j=max(-b_j,0)+z_j with integerz_j>=0. Base cost=sum max(b_j,0)*gap is mandatory.
proof.degreeEquality: Zero total balance on every cut implies all per-vertex degree differences zero by adjacent prefix subtraction, including boundaries since totaldelta0.
proof.componentContraction: All mandatory edges and nonzero-cut minimum corrections form base components. Nonzero-cut endpoints are already in one component; extra balanced pairs there cannot connect different base components. Only zero-cut optional pairs can join them.
proof.mstLowerBound: Any normalized connected augmentation supplies a connected optional edge set on contracted base components. Each extra opposite pair costs itsgap. A nonnegative connected edge set contains a spanning tree, so its cost is at least the optional MST.
proof.mstUpperBound: Kruskal adds both adjacent directions for each selected zero-cut edge. It preserves degree equality and joins all base components; the complete coordinate path guarantees a tree exists. The resulting weak-connected balanced directed multigraph has an Euler circuit. No multiplicity is explicitly materialized in the implementation.
proof.duplicatesAndSelfEdges: Every required pair contributes its own two delta updates, so repeated sections remain distinct requirements; self-pairs cancel locally and remain harmless DSUjoins. If all coordinates are1, V1, aux is a self-edge and answer0.

oracleIndependence.literal: All permutations of labeled section indices; simulate initialspeed1, choose minimum tracklength to each nextentry, check strictly positive accepted speed and reset to that section exit. No auxiliary edge/cut balance/DSU/MST.
oracleIndependence.heldKarp: Separate subset-and-last exact DP on the complete directed transition-cost table, with any first/last. Crosschecked on all5456 binary-speed arrays, then360 random cases including40 full16-section DPs. No Euler or component calculation.
oracleIndependence.metamorphic: Input section-label permutations; translation; reverse the order and transform(s,t)->(1000000001-t,1000000001-s) via a cost-preserving bijection; positive affine scaling. Maximum families use closed formulas, not the production result as oracle.

counterSemantics.checks: Assertions include per-section positive-speed/entry validation on every literal order, so67.5million is not the number of distinct API inputs.
counterSemantics.apiCalls: Successful direct public core wrapper calls only. Original adapter calls counted separately, though each internally invokes core. Fault/invalid direct invocations are separately counted, not falsely included.
counterSemantics.familyOverlap: The second family repeats binary-speed casesN2..5 already in the first; only its4096 N6 arrays are new. Do not add family counters and claim unique inputs.
counterSemantics.allocationFailuresInjected: 22 actual custom-bad_alloc failures: four core and seven adapter allocation sites on each ofN4 andN200000 under tested GCC/libstdc++; exact count not a portable allocation contract.
